integrity: Complete exact-text proof and standalone finite-field coefficient checker supplied; finite checks do not prove the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: The operator families can overlap; the exact numerical counts apply to dimension three over odd finite fields. No conjugacy-class count or higher-dimensional complete rank census is claimed. Unindexed equivalent literature remains a possible originality risk.
title: Rota–Baxter trichotomy and exact ternary finite-field counts for rank-one evolution algebras
